name: 身体交换
desc: 超好玩的身体交换算法，把你的脸融合到别人的身体上，看看衣服是否合身✨？
en_desc: Super fun body swap algorithm, fuse your face to someone else's body to see if the clothes fit ✨?

name: 分类识别
desc: 对小动物进行识别和分类

name: 人脸检测
desc: 468个人脸部关键点精准定位并支持多个人同时检测，支持关键点3D坐标。
en_desc: Accurate positioning of 468 face key points and support for simultaneous detection of multiple people and 3D coordinates of key points.

name: AI换脸
desc: 超好玩的换脸算法，把明星的脸融合到你的身体上，让你也有星范✨
en_desc: The super fun face-changing algorithm, which integrates the star's face into your body, makes you also a star ✨

name: 人脸追踪
desc: 具有6个人脸关键点定位和多张脸同时检测的超轻型面部检测器
en_desc: Ultra-light face detector with 6 face keypoint localization and simultaneous detection of multiple faces

name: 实时头发检测
desc: 超逼真的实时头发分割，并渲染头发为别的色彩，细节到每个发丝。
en_desc: Ultra-realistic real-time hair segmentation and rendering of hair as other colors, detail down to each strand.

name: 手部姿势跟踪
desc: 基于高性能手掌检测和手部关节关键点定位，模型能得到3D的21个关键点，支持双手同时检测。
en_desc: Based on high-performance palm detection and hand joint key point positioning, the model can obtain 21 key points in 3D, supporting simultaneous detection of both hands.

name: 实体检测和追踪
desc: 在单个程序中实时检测和跟踪视频中的对象，并支持aidbot、openbot的玩具小车的控制（通过usb把小车和手机相连接）
en_desc: Detect and track objects in video in real time in a single program, and support the control of aidbot, openbot toy cars (connect the car and mobile phone through usb)

name: 3D对象追踪
desc: 对椅子等日常物品的检测和3D姿势估计
en_desc: Detection and 3D pose estimation of everyday objects such as chairs

name: 实时人体抠图
desc: 超好玩的实时人体抠图分割，把你的人体抠图融合到新的背景上，让你穿越旅行✈️
en_desc: Super fun real-time body cutout segmentation, integrate your body cutout into a new background, allowing you to travel through✈️

name: 车牌识别
desc: 基于AidLux的车牌识别，用于识别车牌的位置以及车牌号
en_desc: License plate recognition based on AidLux, used to identify the location of the license plate as well as the license plate number

name: 人像分割
desc: 识别图像中的人体轮廓

name: 人体姿势检测和跟踪
desc: 高保真人体姿势跟踪，可从RGB视频帧中推断出至少25个3D身体姿态关键点。
en_desc: High-fidelity human pose tracking to infer at least 25 3D body pose keypoints from RGB video frames.
